WITH group_stats AS (
  SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code,
         si.healtheval AS health_safety_status,
         AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_scan_minute,
         COUNT(*) AS scan_count
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
  WHERE s.chronotag::text BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
  GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.healtheval
), with_mean AS (
  SELECT gs.*,
         AVG(avg_gb_per_scan_minute) OVER () AS mean_group_average
  FROM group_stats AS gs
)
SELECT site_code,
       health_safety_status,
       avg_gb_per_scan_minute,
       scan_count,
       avg_gb_per_scan_minute - mean_group_average AS amount_above_mean
FROM with_mean
WHERE mean_group_average IS NOT NULL
  AND avg_gb_per_scan_minute > mean_group_average
ORDER BY amount_above_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
